title: Bananas Are Berries
hook: Strawberries aren't berries, but bananas are
summary: In botany, bananas and tomatoes are berries, while strawberries and raspberries are not.

text: In botany, a banana is a berry.
That puts it on the same team as blueberries.

panels.text: Wait, a banana is a berry?

panels.mean: a fruit that grows from one flower, with its seeds inside the flesh

text: In botany, being a berry has nothing to do with the name.
If it grows from one flower, is soft all the way through,
and has its seeds tucked in the flesh, it's a berry.
So grapes, tomatoes, eggplants and cucumbers are berries too.
The bananas we eat have almost no seeds that can sprout,
but the fruit is still built like a berry.
Strawberries, on the other hand, aren't berries.
Each of those tiny dots on the outside is a fruit of its own,
is the base that held up the flower, swollen up.

panels.text: It has berry in its name and it's not a berry?

text: They're lots of tiny fruits clumped together.
